scope: Homepage and core website pages: About, New Patients, Treatments, FAQ, Contact, Accessibility, Privacy Policy.

Supplied dist.zip: accessibility/index.html, privacy-policy/index.html (existing policy wording, original policy date retained).

assets.hoffman-logo.svg: Exact inline Hoffman SVG extracted from supplied homepage, verified against current live site. home/logo.png in assets.zip is a Calistoga placeholder and was excluded.

review_notes: Marketing headlines and summaries are new draft copy based on supplied practice content.
Doctor credentials, education, office contact details, treatment offerings and FAQ answers are grounded in the supplied export.
Generic template staff, office and before-and-after images were excluded; illustrative photos are not identified as Hoffman staff, premises or patient results.
All core page links now stay within the rebuilt site. External links are limited to maps and existing social accounts.
Jotform is intentionally deferred at user request. src/components/ConsultationRequest.astro contains the working phone/email fallback and insertion point; preserve contact/#form.
No analytics, new booking service, or patient data collection has been added.

Accessibility and privacy wording is carried from the supplied pages, not a new compliance certification. Reconcile the existing privacy wording with the final Jotform configuration before the public launch.
Empty Blog and Invisalign routes are not recreated. Clear aligner content is on Treatments.
Private preview remains noindex; live-domain launch is outside this round.
